raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 3, Reason for Mistake: The Planner accepted misleading search-result snippets (e.g., prabook/wikiwand) without verifying with authoritative sources and prematurely concluded “Gell was German, Leach was Australian.” This led to the wrong final answer; in fact, both Alfred Gell and Edmund Leach were British.
